status: Visual review only; implementation awaits user design approval
flows: Welcome -> How to Play -> Home -> Classic -> Level Complete -> Next Level
Home -> Daily Puzzle or Solo Time Attack
Home -> Live Duel -> optional account prompt -> Lobby -> Matchmaking or Friend Room -> Duel -> Result
Duel -> Reconnecting -> active Duel or Result; timer continues
Home -> Garden -> Decorate; each 50 completed levels unlocks area
Profile -> optional Google sign-in -> cloud save
Profile -> Settings; Shop and Leaderboard accessible from Home/Profile navigation
authoritative_rules: Approved logo is approved-logo.png; mockup approximations must not replace the source asset.
Classic has no countdown; Time Attack and Duel last 60 seconds.
Guest solo play; login optional for backup and required for ranked/friend account features.
No paid boosts or pause in ranked duel.
Coins and Garden Points are separate.
Difficulty tiers: Beginner, Easy, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert; 100 levels each; 500 roadmap target.
review_caveats: Generated mockups are aesthetic proposals, not exact game-state or copy specifications.

Screen 14 includes an extra opponent avatar; remove duplicate in detailed layout.
Screen 16 reconnection success cannot be promised; replace with Trying to reconnect and handle timeout.
Scores, prices, currencies and rewards in all boards are illustrative; leaderboard scoring to be specified, not inferred from leaf icons.
Garden guest/avatar/header values vary in renders; unify sample identity and labels.
Only primary screen and selected tab shown for grouped features; secondary tabs, failure/offline/purchase confirmation states need detailed layout before implementation.
3D appearance is rendered concept art; actual assets, animations, responsiveness and performance are not yet implemented or validated.
